taskReuseDecisionAcceptance.reasoning: Accept the exact splice-pair reuse and narrow gene-coordinate extension. The retained strip already teaches retained exons and untranslated ends but has no promoter-to-DNA alignment. Keeping it and adding only the transcript-specific coding comparison is justified; the shared splicing owner remains untouched.

scientificAssessment.reasoning: The official exon definition explicitly permits untranslated exonic sequence, and HGVS distinguishes continuous transcript references from gapped genomic alignments and requires stable reference identity. The same V marker remains in exon 2 in both transcripts; orange coding coverage includes V only in A. A downstream transcription start and shifted coding start are separate illustrated concepts. The caption explains artificial alignment gaps and continuous processed RNA, labels the example fictional, and retains accession/version and functional RNA boundaries.
